```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(targets)
library(gt)
library(ggplot2)

# save_report_figure() (3_analysis/R/utils.R) returns absolute figure paths
# so they resolve correctly under tar_render()'s knit root (the project
# root, needed for tar_load()/tar_read() to find the _targets/ store) even
# though this .Rmd lives two levels down in 3_analysis/reports/.
# include_graphics() defaults to relativising absolute paths against the
# *document's* directory, which re-breaks that -- disable it so the
# absolute path is embedded as-is.
options(knitr.graphics.rel_path = FALSE)
```

This report is rendered automatically by `targets::tar_make()` (`tarchetypes::tar_render()` target `report_study2_summary`) and always reflects the *current* pipeline outputs — never hand-edit its numbers. See `docs/concept_paper_study2_agronomy_management.md` for the full scientific framing (aim, research questions, hypotheses) behind this pipeline.

## 1. Statistical models — overview

One generic model factory (`3_analysis/R/functions_statistics.R`, `fit_glmm_outcome()`) fit across four outcomes, each including the `FERTILISATION x RESIDUE` interaction the source analyses had not previously tested.

```{r model-overview}
tar_load(model_overview)
model_overview
```

## 7. Land Equivalent Ratio (a-LER) — work in progress

Uses `merged_yield_data` (both PV setups) rather than the VERTICAL-only Study 2 dataset used above. Flagged in the concept paper as needing recalculation against the fully current dataset.

```{r ler}
tar_load(ler_grain_result)
tar_load(ler_clover_result)
if (is.null(ler_grain_result) && is.null(ler_clover_result)) {
  cat("a-LER could not be computed -- see the concept paper's TODOs.")
} else {
  if (!is.null(ler_grain_result)) knitr::kable(ler_grain_result, digits = 2, caption = "a-LER: GRAIN")
  if (!is.null(ler_clover_result)) knitr::kable(ler_clover_result, digits = 2, caption = "a-LER: GRASS_CLOVER")
}
```
